root_cause: The daily SEO/CRO loop executes changes but does not register them in public.social_experiments, so no change has a baseline, a before/after result or a learning record.

actual_sources: public.social_experiments: 0 of 222 rows have pagina or basislijn (read-only query, 2026-10-28)

fix: Skill section that requires registration in the existing register after production readback, one running experiment per page and metric, a control group, and bounded autonomous decision rules.
prevention_rule: Every EXECUTED CRO/SEO change must carry an experiment with a baseline captured at production readback; an uplift is only claimed when the control group moves consistently.
terminal_rule: Policy only. Not terminal until the enforcing migration is live and a first executed change shows a registered experiment with a baseline.
